Problem Description

Troubleshooting
:
As per the reported issue, we understand that DC_Contactor_DC2_QA13-14 has changed to true. Based on our analysis of the logs over the past week on the AWS server, we have detected welding for contactor DC2_QA13-14 multiple times. Please find the attached log file for your reference.
We recommend conducting the following checks on-site:
Check the coils of the contactors by supplying 24V separately.
Verify if the auxiliary contactors of QA13-14 are picking up or dropping properly according to the supply.
Inspect the wiring of the status/feedback of the contactor used for PLC status.
If needed, then contactors need to be replaced,
Please find below attached MLFB of QA13-14 contactor for your reference.
8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
For future reference, your case number is
0416431
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
